wiki.title: Prince of Low Tide
wiki.text:
Were you look for the battle?

The Prince of Low Tide is a cray NPC boss that can be found in the battle of the same name, located in Seaside, where he can be found anywhere on the main beach, on the cove beach, or around the oceanfront homes. He is the cray prince who stealing souvenirs from locals and visitors, it is up to the player to come and defeat him, so he returns to the Cray Caves.
